column1: # OOD-PerceptionBench -- smoke split (acceptance test route selection)
# paths are relative to the canonical routes root; separator is a single TAB
# NOT REPORTABLE. Six-to-nine routes cannot approximate a claim computed over 55 base
# routes. The value of this split is its goldens, never its scores. See ../README.md.
#   path                 route XML, relative to the canonical routes root
#   sha256               digest of that XML, copied from routes/MANIFEST.tsv
#   base_route_id        numeric id shared by all variants of the route
#   prop_blueprint_id    the CARLA blueprint the scenario asks for -- assertion A1's expectation
#   tier                 core (6 routes) | extended (3 further routes)
#   asset_class          native (stock CARLA 0.9.15) | shipped_v0.9 (in the v0.9 content pack)
#   covers               why this route is in the split
